name: _HTTP ( {request} )
purpose: Generic HTTP client built on Insert from URL and cURL: parses a JSON request (url, query, headers, data, dataQuoted, auth, method), URL-encodes the query, builds -H/-u/-X/--data-raw options (multipart forms are turned into -F parts with decoded file data), runs Insert from URL, then returns JSON with status text, numeric code, response headers and body (typed as object, array or string by Content-Type). Exits with no result on an empty request.
external: Insert from URL (step 164, cURL options from $curlOptions)
open_question: secret: step 134 builds `-u user:password` from the request's auth object and step 119 sends caller-supplied headers (Authorization tokens); step 17 also keeps the whole request, credentials included, in global $$REQUEST. SSL certificate verification is off (step 164, VerifySSLCertificates False). Error 1631 with status code 0 returns a JSON failure (steps 168-172).
